meta.about: Stay and budget guidance for ticket F (2026-11-12). Prices appear only where an official page states them, with the page and the date it was read. Town-level prices are not given: use the search links.

tiers.types_zh: DOC 营地、假日公园（营位或简易小屋）、青年旅舍
tiers.types_en: DOC campsites, holiday parks (sites or basic cabins), hostels
tiers.area_zh: 镇外的 DOC 营地或镇边的假日公园；青旅多在镇中心
tiers.area_en: DOC campsites outside town or holiday parks on its edge; hostels are usually central

facts.zh: DOC 标准营地成人每晚 $10–20，服务型营地（不通电营位）成人每晚 $25；个别营地价格不同。
facts.en: DOC Standard campsites: adults $10–20 a night; Serviced campsites (unpowered sites): adults $25 a night; some campsites differ.
facts.label: DOC: Campsite categories, facilities and fees

links.label_zh: 假日公园（新西兰旅游局）

tiers.types_zh: 汽车旅馆（motel）、民宿（B&B）、假日公园的带卫浴小屋
tiers.types_en: Motels, B&Bs, holiday-park cabins with their own bathroom
tiers.area_zh: 镇中心或主路边，开车方便停车
tiers.area_en: The town centre or the main road, with easy parking

facts.zh: 新西兰统计局的住宿调查统计入住和出租率，但不采集金额，所以没有官方公布的全国中档每晚房价。中档价格待核。
facts.en: Stats NZ’s Accommodation Survey counts guest nights and occupancy and does not collect prices, so there is no official nationwide nightly rate for a mid-range stay. The price is to be confirmed.
facts.label: Stats NZ DataInfo+: Accommodation Survey

links.label_zh: 汽车旅馆（新西兰旅游局）

tiers.types_zh: 酒店、精品酒店、山林或湖畔度假小屋（lodge）
tiers.area_zh: 湖边、海边或景观好的镇外位置
tiers.area_en: Lake or sea fronts, or out-of-town spots with views

facts.zh: 同一份统计局住宿调查也不采集高端住宿的房价。没有找到可引用的官方每晚价格，高端价格待核。
facts.en: The same Stats NZ survey does not collect rates for high-end stays either. No official nightly price was found. The price is to be confirmed.
facts.label: Stats NZ DataInfo+: Accommodation Survey

tips.zh: DOC 营地通票：成人 $295、5–17 岁 $147.50，从选定的开始日起一年内有效，可用于 DOC 的营地；同一营地 30 天内最多用 7 晚，带电营位每人每晚另加 $3。
tips.en: DOC Campsite Pass: adults $295, ages 5–17 $147.50, valid for a year from the start date you choose at DOC campsites; at most 7 nights in 30 days at one campsite, plus $3 a person a night on powered sites.
tips.label: DOC: Campsite Pass

tips.zh: DOC 小屋按晚付费：标准小屋成人每晚 $15，服务型小屋成人每晚 $25（Great Walk 小屋另有价格）。DOC 小屋收费页没有写年度小屋通票，是否还有请向 DOC 确认（待核）。
tips.en: DOC huts are paid by the night: Standard huts $15 an adult, Serviced huts $25 an adult (Great Walk huts are priced separately). DOC's hut fee page does not mention an annual hut pass; check with DOC whether one is still sold (to be checked).
tips.label: DOC: Hut categories, facilities and fees

tips.zh: InterCity FlexiPass 巴士通票按小时计，12 个月内有效，可以随时加时，也可用于 Interislander 渡轮和部分一日游。
tips.en: The InterCity FlexiPass bus pass is sold in hours, is valid for 12 months, can be topped up, and also covers the Interislander ferry and selected day tours.
tips.label: InterCity: FlexiPass

zh: 出发前查天气和路况，冬季傍晚天黑得早。NZTA Journey Planner 有实时路况。
封闭的道路不能开，开上去是违法的。
冰雪路面放慢车速；能选的话在白天中段通过山路。
车上备保暖衣物、水和食物，油箱至少留半箱（电车留足电量），以防绕路或等候。
滑雪场上山路可能要求装防滑链；租车保险不一定覆盖高山路段和防滑链，先问租车公司。
en: Check the weather and road conditions before you leave; it gets dark early in winter. NZTA Journey Planner has live updates.
Never drive on a closed road: it is illegal.
Slow down on ice and snow, and cross passes in the middle of the day when you can.
Carry warm clothes, water and food, and keep at least half a tank of fuel (or enough charge) for detours and waits.
Ski-field roads may require chains; rental cover may exclude alpine roads and chains, so ask your rental company first.
